text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 3, 2025) for 822 Roselawn Avenue

The Property Standards Committee – North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (June 3, 2025) for 822 Roselawn Avenue, Folder Number 25 169636 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to October 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
